job.title: Associate AI Engineer (Speech & Audio ML)
job.description: VaniTech (Hyderabad) develops speech recognition and voice synthesis systems for regional dialects. We are looking for an Associate AI Engineer with experience in Whisper, audio feature extraction (MFCC, Spectrograms), PyTorch, and torchaudio.

pool.text: Speech Recognition & Whisper: fine-tuned OpenAI Whisper models on regional accented speech audio
Torchaudio & Librosa: extracted Mel-spectrograms, MFCC features, and applied pitch/speed augmentations
PyTorch Deep Learning: trained Conformer and CTC-loss acoustic models for speech classification
Audio Data Cleaning: processed raw WAV audio, removed silence, and normalized audio loudness (LUFS)
DialectVoice: speech dialect recognition model identifying 4 South Indian dialects with 88% accuracy
B.Tech ECE, BITS Pilani (Hyderabad Campus), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.5/10
Word Error Rate (WER) Evaluation: computed WER and CER benchmarks using jiwer library
Spring Boot: developed simple bookstore REST service
AI Intern at VoiceCraft (Hyderabad, 4 months): annotated and validated 100+ hours of vernacular audio
Python & SciPy: signal processing, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and bandpass filtering
HTML & CSS: created responsive landing page for music festival
Hugging Face Hub: uploaded datasets and model checkpoints with model cards
